{{Quote|We must prevent the Ghrag from acquiring these weapons. They have made contact with a weapons dealer named Vosc Traaer from Naboo. You may have heard of him. He was a supplier for the Empire until he was discovered to be an embezzeler. ''[sic]''|Eyma|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Vosc Traaer''' was a [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]]-like [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] supplier for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. However, he was dismissed from the Empire when it was discovered he was an embezzler. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Eyma]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with intercepting Traaer and [[Death/Legends|killing]] him while he traveling through the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vosc Traaer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
